 About the College
 The Government Model Degree College in Diblong was established by the Government of
 Assam to promote higher education for the people of Dima Hasao. Located in the village of
 Diblong near Hatikhali in Dima Hasao district, the college is approximately 92 km from the
 district headquarters in Haflong and around 27 km from Lumding in Hojai district. The
 foundation stone of the college was laid on November 8, 2020, by Debolal Garlosa, Chief
 Executive Member of the NC Hills Autonomous Council, along with Nandita Garlosa,
 Executive Member and in charge of higher education, NC Hills Autonomous Council. Since
 its inception, the college has been mentored by Maibang Degree College, Maibang. Faculty
 members across various departments were appointed by the Department of Higher Education,
 Government of Assam, in July 2023.
 Prospectus- 2024-25


 Message from Principal’s Desk
 “Education to be complete, must be humane, it must include not
 only training of intellectual but refinement of the heart and
 discipline of the spirit. No education can be regarded as complete
 if it neglect heart and spirit”
                                 Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan


 Dear Students, Faculty, and Community Members,

 It is with immense pride and joy that I welcome you to Government
 Model Degree College, Diblong, a promising new institution              Sujit Kumar Sinha
 established in 2023 under the Pradhan Mantri Ucchatar Shiksha              Principal, i/c
 Abhiyan (PM-USHA). Located in the serene hill district of Dima      Government Model Degree
 Hasao, Assam, our college stands as a beacon of hope and                 College, Diblong
 opportunity for quality higher education in the region. Our
 establishment marks a significant milestone in the journey to make higher education
 accessible to students in remote and underserved areas of Assam, enhancing the state’s
 educational infrastructure and paving the way for academic growth and empowerment.

 With the creation of 18 teaching posts across six core disciplines—Assamese, English,
 Education, Economics, History, and Political Science—the college launched its first
 academic session for 2023-2024. While the journey has begun, we are awaiting the
 finalization of the Principal, Librarian, and non-teaching staff positions, which are expected
 to be completed soon.

 In this initial phase, due to infrastructure development, we are grateful to Maibang Degree
 College for hosting our classes temporarily. We anticipate relocating to our own campus by
 early 2025, where students and faculty will have access to facilities tailored to their academic
 needs, providing a conducive environment for growth and learning.

 As we embark on this journey together, I encourage each of you to make the most of this
 opportunity, engage wholeheartedly in your studies, and contribute to the legacy we are
 building. Together, we will shape a brighter future for our community and ensure that the
 Government Model Degree College, Diblong, becomes a cherished center of knowledge and
 development in Dima Hasao and beyond.



 Warm Regards

 Sujit Kumar Sinha

 Principal (i/c)

 COURSES OFFERED:
 The College offers courses of studies leading to BA (Three/ Four Year Degree course both in
 General and Honours Courses. The course is affiliated to Assam University, Silchar and is
 governed by the rules and regulations of the University. The courses comprise of Six/ Eight
 Semesters of Six months’ duration each. The Degree is awarded on successful completion of
 Six/Eight semesters having passed in Six/Eight End semester examinations conducted by
 Assam University.

 ELIGIBILITY FOR ADMISSION TO 1st SEMESTER OF B.A:
 For seeking admission to the first semester of B.A a candidate must have passed Higher
 Secondary Examination or equivalent 10+2 Standard of Council/ Board recognized by the
 State/ Central government authorities.

 NUMBER OF SEATES IN FIRST SEMESTER:
 There are only 250 seats in the College
 COURSE STRUCTURE SUBJECTS AND COMBINATIONS FYUG:
 FYUG- Bachelor of Arts (B.A.):
 a) Discipline Specific Core (DSC) Subjects:

 Economics, Assamese, Education, English, History and Political Science.
 b) Discipline Specific Minor (DSC) Subjects:

 Economics, Assamese, Education, English, History and Political science.
 c) Inter- Disciplinary Courses(DSM) Subjects:
 Prospectus- 2024-25


 Economics, Assamese, Education, English, History and Political Science.
 d) Ability Enhancement Courses (AEC): 1. General English, Alternative English and
 Communicative English (AECC) 2. Modern Indian Language (MIL)-Assamese (ASML)
 e) Skill Enhancement Courses (SEC) Subjects:
 Economics, Education, Assamese, English, History and Political Science

 f) Value Added Courses (VAC) Subjects: NCC/NSS and Understanding India
 A students has to take total 7 papers i.e. three core courses, one multidisciplinary course, one
 value added course, one skill enhancement course and one ability enhancement course.

 College Uniform:
 The Govt. Model Degree College has a uniform dress code for both boys and grils.
 Boys: White Shirt, Grey Trouser, Grey Tie, Black shoes and White Socks.
 Girls: Grey Salwar, White Kameez, Grey Dupatta, (V- Shape with 6 inches plate), Black
 footwear and White Socks.
         College uniform is compulsory for all students and no other dress will be allowed
 within the college premises.
 THE COLLEGE LIBRARY
 The college library has been modernized with SOUL software and fully digitized. It offers
 ample space and comfortable accommodations for reading. The collection of books is
 adequate to cover the subjects taught at the college. Additionally, several key newspapers,
 periodicals, journals, and magazines, both online and in print, are regularly subscribed to. A
 digital library with Wi-Fi access is also available for the convenience of faculty and students.
 Library opening Hours are as follows:
 Week days: 10A.M. To 4 P.M
 Saturday: 10 A.M. To 2 P.M
 Issue time: 11 A.M. To 1 P.M.

 ADMISSION PROCEDURE
 1. Admission to the College is through online process only in the prescribed Application
 Form available in the website of Samarthhttps://assamadmission.samarth.ac.in
 2. Notice prescribing the last date of Admission is hung up in the college notice board and
 college website usually a few days before or after the declaration of the result of the
 qualifying examination.
 3. The Admission Form must be filled in completely in all respects and the hard copy of the
 Application must be submitted with the supporting documents. Incomplete Form(s) will be
 rejected straightway.
 4. Admission process is conducted under the direct control of the Admission committee. In
 case of admission to the ‘Honours Course, the rules of Assam University and the decision of
 the concerned department will be binding.
  5. Admission is strictly on merit and is governed by the admission rules framed by the
 ADMISSION Committee. The decision of the chairperson of the admission Committee
 stands final.
 6. Any under pressure or interference in the matter (s) of admission will be treated as
 disqualification.
  7. The self-attested copies of the following documents (two Copies each) are to be furnished
 along with the hardcopy Application Form:

     Mark Sheet, Certificate, Admit Card and Registration Card of HSLC
     Character Certificate.
      SC/ST/OB/MOBC Certificate.
      Permanent Residential Certificate.
      Gap certificate from appropriate authority in case the student who passed the qualifying
      examination earlier than the current year.
     Original Migration/Transfer Certificate for the students seeking admission other than in
      the 1st Semester.
     Latest passport size photograph. (4 copies)
  8. The original copies of the attested documents must be produced before the Admission
  Committee.
  9. Presence of the Candidate on the date of interview/admission before the Admission
  Committee is compulsory.
  10. The fees (if there be any) for admission must be paid on the date of admission after the
  approval from the Admission Committee.
   11. No request for admission will be entertained after the prescribed date(s) fixed by the
  authorities concerned.
  12. There is reservation of seats for the student belonging to SC, ST (P), ST (H), OBC
  (including MOBC) and physically Handicapped (PH) categories as per Government rules.
  Valid certificate issued by the competent authority must be produced in original before the
 Prospectus- 2024-25


  Admission Committee on the date of admission and the Xerox Copy must be attached with
  the Application Forms. The reservation of seats is as follows:
  *SC-7%
  *STP- 10%
  *STH- 5%
   *OBC/MOBC- 15%
   *PH- 3%
 13. Admission in other semesters i.e. 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th and 8th will be completed
 within 7 days after completion of the earlier end semester examinations on provisional basis.
 The provisional admission is to be regularized (for those who fulfil the eligibility conditions
 of the University) within seven days from the publication of the results of the earlier
 semester.
 14. Request for the permission for late admission shall not be entertained.
 ADMISSION FEE STRUCTURE (FOR THE SESSION 2024-25)
 The admission fee structure is notified by the Principal following the direction of the
 Government of Assam issued from time to time. The Registration and Examination Fees of
 the Assam University are to be paid during online application for the same.
 COLLEGE TRANSFER/PROVISIONAL PASS CERTIFICATE
 For a pass certificate/transfer certificate one has to apply two days ahead along with the
 following clearance certificates:
 1. Fee clearance certificate from the college office.
 2. Library clearance certificate.
 3. NCC/NSS clearance certificate.
 4. Clearance certificate from student Union Office
 5. Surrender of college Identity Card (only in case of transfer certificate).
 6. Clearance certificate from the hostel (if hostel boarder)
 GENERAL RULES FOR MAINTANCE OF DISCIPLINE THE COLLEGE
 1. The college lays great emphasis on discipline and character building of the students. The
 rules and the regulations of the college are binding to all students of the college.
 2. Only such individuals, societies or Association as have been recognised/approved by the
 Principal, shall have the facilities to the College premises.
 3. At the time of admission, the students and the parents/ guardians are required to furnished
 an undertaking in respect of the student’ regular attendance in the class and appearance in the
 college and university examination as per guidelines/ instructions as specified by the
 concerned authorities.
 Prospectus- 2024-25


  4. The rules concerning the attendance in the class of the students are strictly maintained in
 accordance to the instruction of Assam University, Silchar which is notified by the college
 authority at the beginning of the academic session. The rules for non-collegiate and dis-
 collegiate will be strictly adhered to.
 5. The rules concerning college examination are strictly accorded to the Examination
 Committee of the college. And for the university examinations the eligibility conditions and
 instructions of the university will be strictly followed.
 6. The following activities of the students in this college will be treated as serious offences.
 All powers for disciplinary actions against the offences are vested with the Principal and the
 Academic Committee of the College and their decision shall be final in all such matters.
       Encouraging and participating in ragging of any types.
       Forcible disruption of class.
       Destruction of college properties.
       Misbehaviour shown towards girls, women, teachers and employees of the college.
       Uses of drugs, alcohol, narcotics, smoking inside the college campus.
       Providing any wrong information to the college authority.
       Damaging and losing of library books of the college.
       And any other activities that may detriment the academic atmosphere of the college
 7. Students are to keep the photo-identity card of the college with them in the college
 premises and they may have to produce it on demand. The identity cards shall be made
 available to the students within 15 days from the date of admission. The identity Cards are to
 be renewed in each academic year. The old identity cards are to be submitted for renewal at
 the beginning of the new academic year. Loss of identity card must be reported to the college
 office immediately and applied for a duplicate one with proper documentation and cost.
 8. College uniform for the students is a must while they are in the college campus during
 routine hours (excepts for NCC/NSS/cultural/ sports practices/ activities)
 9. Use of mobile phone by the students within the classrooms, examination halls and in any
 of the meetings of the college is strictly prohibited.
 10. Students’ union will be strictly guided by the constitution of the Govt. Model Degree
 College, Diblong Students’ Union and such instructions that college authority may notify
 from time to time.
 11. Any notices desired to be pasted or circulated by the GMDCSU or any individual students
 anywhere in the college premises shall require the approval of the principal.
 12. All powers of maintenance of discipline are vested with the Principal and his/her decision
 shall be final in all such matters.

                                    PROFILE OF THE DEPARTMENTS


                                          DEPARTMENT OF ASSAMESE
    About the Department:
    The Assamese Department at Govt. Model Degree College, Diblong, Dima Hasao, is
    dedicated to developing a collaborative teaching method by inviting the students to practice
    thinking together through Assamese literature and language. Our task will be to introduce
    topics, issues, concepts, ideas, etc., related to the Assamese literary scene from the vantage
    point of an expert and generate discussions among the students through such talks and
    discussions.

    Vision:
    The Assamese Department is committed to contributing to the institution's community and
    corporate activities, extending our influence beyond the classroom.

    Mission:
    Our mission is for the students to develop critical and creative observations, which can help
    them bring nuance to their reading and writing of texts. We strongly believe that the
    interdisciplinary approach, which we emphasize in our teaching is highly enriching for
    literary studies, including Assamese.

                                  DEPARTMENT OF ENGLISH
 About the Department:
 The Department of English at Government Model Degree College, Diblong offers an
 extensive as well as comprehensive curriculum that fosters the all-round development of
 students encouraging and cultivating critical thinking, communication skills, and socio-
 cultural awareness. With the introduction of a Four-Year Undergraduate programme under
 National Education Policy 2020, affiliated with Assam University Silchar, the department
 strives to “producing engaged, productive, and contributing citizens for building an equitable,
 inclusive, and plural society as envisaged by our Constitution” (NEP 2020).
 Objectives:
    1. To provide students with a thorough understanding of literary devices, themes, and
       historical background.
    2. To enable students to critically assess literary texts and actively participate in
       meaningful discussions and debates regarding the significance of literature in society
       and culture.
    3. To develop proficiency in reading, writing, and oral communication.
    4. To foster creativity, allowing students to produce creative works of their own.
    5. To nurture and promote the holistic development of students as envisaged in NEP
       2020.

                                   DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMICS
    About the Department:
    The Department of Economics is one of the first six inaugural departments of the
    Government Model Degree College, Diblong, which commenced its operations in July 2023.
    This department plays a pivotal role in delivering high-quality education in both 'Major' and
    'Minor' courses within the framework of the Four-Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP)
    in accordance with the NEP-2020 Curriculum, affiliated with Assam University, Silchar. The
    Department is equipped with three dedicated faculty members who possess expertise in
    Mathematical Economics, Advanced Econometrics, and Financial Economics. Moreover, the
    faculties are committed to providing rigorous instruction and fostering a comprehensive
    understanding of economic principles among students. Their objective is to equip students
    with a robust foundational knowledge of Economics, thereby enhancing their potential to
    contribute effectively to the nation's economic development.
    Vision:
        1. The department prioritizes the development of analytical thinking, quantitative skills,
           and policy analysis, equipping students for professional opportunities in banking,
           finance, government, and international organizations.
        2. To enhance the social accountability of students, the Department will periodically
           implement a range of social and community outreach programs.

    Mission:
              1. To facilitate transformative change in individuals and advance societal progress,
                 the Department is devoted to delivering an educational experience that integrates
                 the dissemination of knowledge with the inculcation of fundamental values.
              2. To organise seminars and workshops on various socio-economic issues that hinder
                 the economic progress of the local people, especially for the people of the hilly
                 terrain.
              3. To employ innovative educational tools and technologies, such as online teaching
                 platforms (e.g., Google Meet, Zoom) and the sharing of educational resources
                 (e.g., Google Classroom, ePathshala) to familiarize students with the latest
                 technology.

                                   DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION
 About the Department:
 The Department of Education was created concurrently with the college's inception
 in 2023. The Department of Education is committed to delivering high-quality
 education and training to students, equipping them with the skills and knowledge
 necessary to excel in the field of education. Currently, the Department comprises of
 3(three) faculties and offers BA (Bachelor of Arts) Programme aligned with the
 NEP 2020 (National Education Policy) 2020.

 Vision:
 "We envision developing the Department as a leading Advance Centre for creating
 learner- centred, humane, and socially responsible educational professionals,
 committed to equity, excellence, and transformative impact."
 Mission:
 1. Empowering educators, enriching communities, and enhancing lives through
     innovativeteaching, learning, and research.
 2. Preparing compassionate, critically thinking, and creative educators who
     inspire andtransform the lives of their students.
 3. Fostering a culture of excellence, equity, and social justice in education,
     preparing leaderswho make a positive impact.
 4. Transforming lives through education, promoting academic excellence, and
     supporting theholistic development of students, educators, and communities.
 5. Developing educators who are informed, reflective, and adaptive, committed
     to the pursuitof knowledge and the betterment of society.
 6. Preparing educators to address the challenges of a rapidly changing world,
     fosteringresilience, creativity, and global citizenship.
 7. Advancing education as a powerful tool for personal growth, social mobility,
     andcommunity development.

                                   DEPARTMENT OF HISTORY
 “History is the study of the past with the aim of understanding it, and it is through this
 understanding that we gain insight into the present and guide our future.”
 — Johan Huizinga

 ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT:
 The Department of History at Govt. Model Degree College, Diblong, emphasizes on
 fostering independent research, encouraging intellectual curiosity, and promoting a deep
 understanding of historical context. We believe that understanding history is key to
 understanding the present and shaping the future. The Department is proud to offer the Four-
 Year Undergraduate Program (FYUGP), designed to introduce students to the foundational
 concepts and methodologies of historical study. Our aim is to inspire a passion for history
 while equipping students with essential skills for academic success.

 MISSION:
 The Department of History at Govt. Model Degree College, Diblong, emphasizes on
 fostering independent research, encouraging intellectual curiosity, and promoting a deep
 understanding of historical context. Our mission is to develop students' analytical skills,
 challenge established narratives, and foster a profound comprehension of how history informs
 the present and shapes the future. We aim to be a leading centre for historical scholarship and
 education, where students and faculty collaborate to advance knowledge. We believe that
 understanding history is key to understanding the present and shaping the future. The goal is
 to cultivate historians who can contribute thoughtfully to academic discussions and broader
 social understanding.

 VISION:

 The Vision is to become a leading institution for historical inquiry and education,
 distinguished by our commitment to excellence in research and teaching. Our goal is to
 prepare students to become thoughtful historians who contribute meaningfully to scholarly
 debates and societal discussions, and to promote a comprehensive appreciation of history's
 role in shaping the present and future.

                         DEPARTMENT OF POLITICAL SCIENCE
 About the Department:
 The Department of Political Science at Government Model Degree College, Diblong offers
 an extensive four-year undergraduate program that seeks to cultivate a thorough
 understanding of political Science. With a dedicated, young and experienced faculty, the
 department is committed to delivering high-quality education and personalized mentorship to
 its students. Beyond traditional classroom, the department places a strong emphasis on
 fostering research, promotion of critical thinking, and imparting practical knowledge within
 the field of political science. The department also offers courses on specific areas of political
 science, such as international relations, public administration, human rights, comparative
 politics, political theory, and political thoughts. The department also has a departmental
 library with a wide range of academic books, scholarly journals, and reference resources, all
 of which contribute to a strong learning and research atmosphere. The department also
 organizes a range of extracurricular activities and academic discussion including workshops,
 conferences and seminar to facilitate the students’ engagement with academicians in the field
 of political science.
         The curriculum is designed to provide students with both a strong theoretical
 foundation and the practical skills necessary for diverse career paths, including roles in public
 administration, academia, law etc. With its innovative teaching methods and committed
 faculty, the Department of Political Science is dedicated to shaping the next generation of
 leaders and informed, engaged citizens.
 Vision:
 To be a center of excellence in political science education and research by fostering critical
 thinking and comprehensive understating of political system and political issues among
 students.
 Mission:
 The mission of the department is to provide a comprehensive understanding of political
 science combines theoretical knowledge and practical skills. The department aims to
 fostering research, critical thinking and imparting practical knowledge within the field of
 political science. Furthermore, the department places great importance on preparing students
 for professions in politics, academia, law, public administration, and international relations.
